pipeline.name: Team Collaboration Brief
pipeline.description: Turn a one-line problem statement into a hand-off brief for a teammate: scope, acceptance criteria, suggested approach, and a draft GitHub issue. Demonstrates the v0.3 multi-user import flow — the importer becomes the owner, no user_id is embedded in this bundle.

tpl_team_scope.name: Scope Extractor
tpl_team_scope.prompt_template:
<agent_prompt version="1">
  <role>{{ role }}</role>
  <task>
    From the user's free-form problem statement, extract three structured fields:
      - title: a ~50-char summary suitable as a GitHub issue title
      - scope: 1-2 sentences naming what is in/out
      - constraints: any obvious must-haves (e.g. "keep public API", "no new deps")

    Return ONLY in the <output> block.
  </task>
  <problem_statement>{{ problem_statement }}</problem_statement>
  <constraints>
    If the problem statement is empty or non-actionable, return title="(empty)" and scope="(no scope)".
  </constraints>
</agent_prompt>

tpl_team_brief.name: Brief Drafter
tpl_team_brief.prompt_template:
<agent_prompt version="1">
  <role>{{ role }}</role>
  <task>
    Draft a hand-off brief for a teammate picking this up. Use the scoped
    inputs to produce:
      - acceptance_criteria: 3-5 bullet checklist of done conditions
      - approach: 2-4 sentence suggested implementation path
      - risks: 1-3 things the teammate should verify before merging

    Be concrete but don't over-prescribe — the teammate is the one
    doing the work.
  </task>
  <title>{{ title }}</title>
  <scope>{{ scope }}</scope>
  <constraints>{{ constraints }}</constraints>
</agent_prompt>

tpl_team_issue.name: GitHub Issue Formatter
tpl_team_issue.prompt_template:
<agent_prompt version="1">
  <role>{{ role }}</role>
  <task>
    Format the brief as a GitHub issue body in GFM. Sections:
      ## Context
      (use the scope + constraints)

      ## Acceptance criteria
      (one ``- [ ]`` per bullet from acceptance_criteria)

      ## Suggested approach
      (use approach)

      ## Risks
      (use risks)

    Return ``github_issue_title`` (use the input title verbatim) and
    ``github_issue_body`` in the <output> block. The operator pipes
    ``github_issue_body`` to ``gh issue create --body-file -`` next.
  </task>
  <title>{{ title }}</title>
  <scope>{{ scope }}</scope>
  <constraints>{{ constraints }}</constraints>
  <acceptance_criteria>{{ acceptance_criteria }}</acceptance_criteria>
  <approach>{{ approach }}</approach>
  <risks>{{ risks }}</risks>
</agent_prompt>
